card.name: Violent deaths in news accounts
card.fires_on: Punctuation, linking words and numbers inside descriptions of killings, beatings or deadly disasters, just before the next violent act or victim count.

modes.label: Chain of violent acts
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between acts of violence against a victim, such as beaten, raped, killed, burned.
modes.example: After being kidnapped, she was brutally beaten<<,>> raped, and killed.

modes.label: Death toll or date digits
modes.description: Digits in a casualty count or a year after a deadly disaster or earthquake.
modes.example: The bridge was built after the span across the Firth of Tay collapsed, killing 7<<5>> people on a train in the middle of

modes.label: Cause of death phrasing
modes.description: Small words in phrases about how someone died, such as shot and killed or died of a gunshot wound.
modes.example: On July 27, three unidentified persons shot<< and>> killed Kleb Un, SRP commune
